audit.why: Riot's Q text is damage plus interrupting channels — there is no silence, and Lux has no channel for it to interrupt either. The interaction that IS real and was already half-stated: Light Binding binds up to two enemy units, so the first minion in the line eats it and her whole combo never opens. Kassadin's passive also ignores unit collision, so he can sit inside his own wave to force that.
audit.corrected: Silence removed; the minion-block on Light Binding stated with the reason it works.
Light Binding a flat 10s at every rank from 1175 units; Lucent Singularity 10s to 8s; Prismatic Barrier 12s; Final Spark 60/50/40s from 3340 units.
